WITH item_manufact AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk 
    FROM item 
    WHERE i_manufact_id = 816
)
SELECT dt.d_year,
       item.i_brand_id brand_id,
       item.i_brand brand,
       sum(ss_sales_price) sum_agg
FROM date_dim dt
JOIN store_sales ON ss_sold_date_sk = dt.d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
JOIN item ON true
WHERE dt.d_moy = 11
GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_brand, item.i_brand_id
ORDER BY dt.d_year DESC, sum_agg DESC, brand_id LIMIT 100
